description: Get the receipts for one image by ID - where it came from (who added it and when, the credit printed on it, its publisher and versions), what it claims about the world (each checkable claim restated neutrally, with the source the image itself names), and what the data says (charts from the original publishers - Our World in Data, Eurostat, USDA ERS, EEA - that measure the same thing, with period, unit and a link). Use it when the user asks whether an image is true, where it comes from or what backs it. No verdict: the claims are the image's own, and an empty data list means MemeStack holds no publisher chart for that measure. The first ask for an image reads it and can take several seconds.

id.description: Image UUID (from search_images, get_image or any result)

name: get_receipts

outputSchema.description: Where the image came from, what it claims and what the publishers' data says. No verdict.

claims.description: The checkable claims the image makes about the world.

cites.description: The source the image itself names for this claim, as printed.

claim.description: What the image says, restated neutrally ("The image says ...").

data.description: Publisher charts that measure the same thing ([] = none in the collection); null = not checked this time.

items.description: A chart from an original publisher that measures what the claim is about. MemeStack's own record of the publisher's chart - not a judgment of the claim.

citation.description: The publisher's own short citation for the data, when the chart has one.

id.description: Image UUID of the chart on MemeStack (get_image reads it).

period.description: The period the chart shows, e.g. "2000-2020".

publisher.description: The publisher, e.g. "Our World in Data", "Eurostat".

source_url.description: The chart's page at the publisher.

sources_named.description: Every source printed on the image.

status.description: ok = claims below; none = the image makes no checkable claim; unavailable = not read this time (ask again later).

note.description: How to present the receipts: evidence for the user to weigh, never a verdict.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 time the image was added.

credit.description: The credit or signature printed on the image, as printed; null until the image is read.

kind.description: upload, publisher, web, 4chan, telegram, x, reverse, generated, agent, imgflip or unknown.

label.description: One plain line, e.g. "Imported from Our World in Data".

link.description: The publisher's page or the original post, when there is one.

publisher.description: A publisher chart's own record: name, citation, period, unit.

versions.description: Two or more visible versions of the image: count, earliest_id, earliest_added_at.

read_at.description: When the image was read, or null when it was not.
